decision.reasoning_trace: I specifically looked for items fitting the backpack category rather than general camping gear. I compared the Fox Outdoor NATO style rucksack, two tactical/sling style bags, a budget laptop bag, and a packable daypack. The ZOMAKE Packable Backpack (prod_backpacks_099) stood out because of the high level of customer satisfaction in the reviews, with one user claiming it was their 13th purchase from the brand due to its strength and portability. At $16.49, it offers excellent value for a secondary or light hiking bag.
